episode_summary: Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time homebuyers overcome financial obstacles by using creative financing solutions like seller and lender credits. He emphasizes the importance of optimizing Google business profiles and leveraging bilingual marketing to reach the Hispanic community. The episode also highlights the significance of continuous skill development in the face of advancing AI technologies.
